_schema: publish batch manifest v1 — revision / batch_id / reviewer / candidate_rule_ids (registry rule_id values, in execution dependency order). Permission is NOT stored here: final_decision is read from the signed register.
obsolete_detail: 本文件是 Wave-01 的**原始 planning artifact**，已被 BATCH-01A / BATCH-02 收窄执行完毕，且其中 w01-3a04d4d1aa（迪士尼 other 基底）与 w01-6f2bfd39d7（动物园 other 基底）的语义已被 SCOPE-REMODEL-R2 的 dog/cat/other 三条基底取代（见 docs/governance/superseded_semantics.json）。实测：今天重跑本清单，那两行的 publication_type=SUPERSEDE_ACCESS_RULE，supersedes 分别命中 0d2f70f8（迪士尼 other）与 352f6e0f（动物园 other）——即 Scope Remodel R2 发布出来的现行规则。执行本文件会让旧语义回退覆盖新规则。加载器现在对 execution_status 属于 {OBSOLETE, NON_EXECUTABLE, OBSOLETE_NON_EXECUTABLE, SUPERSEDED_NON_EXECUTABLE} 的清单一律 BatchManifestError 硬拒（dry-run 与 execute 均拒绝）。需要发布新的业务对象时，必须另立新的 dependency-closed 清单。
note: Wave-01 first publish batch. 13 of the 15 human-APPROVED candidates: 11 AccessRule + 2 RuleException. Narrowed from 15 to 13 by two distinct pre-publish failures, neither of which reverses a human decision — both rows stay APPROVED in the signed register. (1) w01-305fa08c1e (上海迪士尼乐园 导盲犬 carve-out) is BLOCKED by the canonical gate: its proposed_conditions use the key 'type' where the gate requires 'condition_type'. The same ingest defect affects 10 of 31 Wave-01 candidates but this is the only APPROVED row it touches; the other 9 are HOLD/REJECTED and unpublishable for their own reasons. It is ALSO measured inert (base animal_scope='other' resolves to {other_pet} under ADR-025 and therefore does not govern guide_dog), so it would have been refused by ZERO INERT RULES as well. (2) w01-4e217d5810 (世纪公园) passes the canonical gate but the publisher's atomic ADR-021 precondition refuses a weak-evidence (search_snippet) APPROVED row: its source carries capture_method=search_snippet / needs_verification=True, i.e. only a search snippet was ever captured, never the operator's page. It needs a first-party re-capture, not a re-review. The Disney BASE (w01-3a04d4d1aa) is deliberately still in this batch: its only approved carve-out is unreachable, and under the canonical rule an inert carve-out does NOT create a shipping obligation on its base — blocking a base on an inert carve-out would let a modelling defect hold real rules hostage. HUMAN APPROVED is not equal to publishable; this manifest narrows only.
